lines: Driver. Deliver parcels, collect payments,
and find fuel stations.
Drivers see nearby jobs and accept one
with a single swipe.
(Sped up 2×) The app guides the driver to
each customer, turn by turn.
At the door, the app checks the parcel,
records who received it, and saves a photo
as proof.
Cash on delivery is recorded in the app
with one swipe.
(Sped up 2×) After each delivery, the app
routes the driver to the next customer.
Low on fuel?
The app finds the nearest fuel station.
(Sped up 3×) The app guides the driver to
the fuel station.
Tap Done after refuelling, and the app
goes back to the delivery route.
(Sped up 2×) The route continues to the
next customer.
Customer. Book a parcel pickup and track
your parcel.
Customers use the app to send parcels and
track them.
Choose the pickup location by moving the
map.
Search the area, then add the street and
house number for the delivery.
Add the receiver's details and choose a
pickup time.
The app shows the price before booking.
Customers can pay in cash on delivery.
Once booked, the app gives the customer a
tracking code.
Customers can pay the fee by scanning an
MMQR code with their banking app.
The payment shows on the order right away,
so the rider collects no cash.
Manager. Manage all deliveries from one
place.
The manager dashboard shows today's
deliveries at a glance.
All orders appear in one list, each with
its delivery route on the map.
The app automatically groups new requests
into jobs for drivers.
Live tracking shows every driver's
location on the map.
Route planning builds the day's routes and
updates them when orders are added.
The vehicles page shows which vehicles are
ready for delivery.
The cash ledger shows how much each driver
has collected.
Oern. Door-to-door delivery for Yangon.
Try it at oern-app.vercel.app.
